            rep_idx += 1

    tasks_completed = row[13]

    if isinstance(cal_burned, str) or isinstance(tasks_completed, str):

    if cal_burned < 800 and tasks_completed > 3:

    coding = row[12]
    study = row[1]

        coding_minutes_list.append(coding)
    if study is not None and not isinstance(study, str):
        study_minutes_list.append(study)

    coding_stdev = 0
elif len(coding_minutes_list) == 1:
    coding_stdev = 0
else:

elif len(study_minutes_list) == 1:
    study_stdev = 0
else:
    study_stdev = statistics.stdev(study_minutes_list)

print(f"Study minutes stdev: {study_stdev}")

# Calculate absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(coding_stdev - study_stdev)
result = round(abs_diff, 2)

print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {result}")
